scope: Bilingual documentation and one new bilingual use-side addressing diagram; no implementation or experiment changes.
confirmed_definitions: PA (Page Attention) has been renamed CA (Chain Attention); PA is retained as the former name.
Use-side addressing follows CA → EA → KA. This is not a fixed single-pass order for all learning or training.
Learning event chain remains EA. Knowledge-package and EA learning loops retain mutual adaptation and revision.
source_scope: Direct U-CA-1107 author confirmation controls the name and use-side order. F50 feedback supplies comparison context, not certification of v18.1/v19 code or experimental success. No private attachment, local machine paths, or conversation identifiers are distributed.
superseded_status: Earlier current-document statements that PA/CA naming and expansion were unresolved are replaced and preserved as historical resolution notes.

offline_protocol_tests.scope: Existing synthetic/double protocols only, not CA/EA/KA implementation validation.

release_scan.limits: Heuristic review, not a guarantee of absence of all sensitive content or rights issues.
